Builds clean with no extra flags under gcc 13 (-std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror, ASan/UBSan) and
zig cc -target arm-linux-gnueabi.2.13 -mcpu=cortex_a9 -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -fPIC.
Used by mods/dj_link.c (byte mode only via qrcodegen_encodeBinary).
